headline: Can you name the 3 parts of the brainstem?
body:
Midbrain: eye movements
Pons: face, hearing, balance
Medulla oblongata: breathing, heartbeat, swallowing

headline: Aortic arch branches? Remember ABC'S
stat_note: Aortic arch gives B, C, S
body:
Brachiocephalic trunk
left Common carotid
left Subclavian
This 3-branch pattern is seen in about 75% of people.

headline: How much blood does your heart pump in a day?
body: At rest, an adult heart often beats 60 to 100 times a minute. By age 70, it will have beaten more than 2.5 billion times.
source: Source: University Hospitals, About the Heart and Blood Vessels
